description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity named ActivityB that demonstrates the lifecycle callback methods of Android activities. It manages UI components to display the activity's lifecycle status and provides methods to start other activities or finish itself.

classes.name: ActivityB
classes.description: An Android Activity subclass that demonstrates lifecycle callback methods and updates UI elements with lifecycle states.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and updates the lifecycle status.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Called when activity becomes visible; updates lifecycle status.

methods.name: onRestart
methods.description: Called when activity is restarting after being stopped; updates status.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Called when activity starts interacting with the user; updates status.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Called when activity is partially obscured; updates status.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Called when activity is no longer visible; updates status.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Called before activity is destroyed; updates status.
